market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month ~$99 entering May 2026 with 1 month window. The market is intraday 'High' on a 1-min candle, easier to trigger than a settlement. Reaching $110 is +11% in ~31 days; given current vol regime and $113 spike already seen this year, a single headline-driven spike to $110 is plausible but not the median outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Single-day geopolitical headline risk vs deflation of the Hormuz premium.
